newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt pain relievers approved by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt pain relievers approved by FDA.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Group Inc said on Tuesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved for marketing two new pain management products.
The first product is a new dosage strength of medication combining the pain relievers acetaminophen and hydrocodone, an opiate-based narcotic. It is scheduled for introduction September 1.
The second is UltraJect pre-filled syringes of morphine sulfate, scheduled for market introduction in January, 1997.
The hydrocodone/acetaminophen product will be sold under the name Anexsia. The product is taken orally to treat moderate to moderately severe pain.
Mallinckrodt makes bulk forms of hydrocodone and acetaminophen.

UltraJect morphine sulfate injection was approved in two dosage strengths, Mallinckrodt said. Morphine sulfate is used to treat moderate to severe pain such as that associated with post-operative surgical pain or cancer.
